# Nuked OPL3

An emulator of the Yamaha YMF262 (OPL3) FM sound chip, by Nuke.YKT.
Viceroy uses it to turn the register writes of its music player into sound.
It is not game code.

- Upstream: https://github.com/nukeykt/Nuked-OPL3
- Version: 1.8, commit `765ec962e473aeb767e4cba74ffdc8f588ffbfe8`
- License: GNU LGPL 2.1 or later (see `LICENSE`), which is compatible with
  Viceroy's GPL 3.0 or later.

`opl3.c` and `opl3.h` are copied unchanged.
